description: This file defines the SimpleConsistentRingProvider class, which manages a consistent hash ring for cluster silos by maintaining references to the next silo in the ring, including logic for finding successors based on hash codes.

classes.name: SimpleConsistentRingProvider
classes.description: Aids in constructing a consistent hash ring by maintaining an up-to-date reference to the next silo in the ring.

classes.name: VersionedSuccessor
classes.description: A private nested class representing a successor with an associated membership version.

methods.name: SimpleConsistentRingProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ring provider with local silo details and cluster membership service.

methods.name: Successor
methods.description: Property that retrieves the next silo in the ring, updating the reference if the cluster snapshot has changed.

methods.name: FindSuccessor
methods.description: Private method to find the next silo in the ring based on hash codes and cluster membership snapshot.
